fill_instructions: When the confirmed itinerary arrives: (1) set each line's `actual` to the confirmed/paid amount (USD), (2) set `covered_by` to prize/self/TBD per line, (3) the totals row on costs.html § 5b recomputes from this file's estimates until you overwrite them. Everything with an empty `actual` is an estimate, not a quote.

items.name: Flights SFO↔MLA (round trip)
items.price_range: Market band $611–963 RT mid-Oct (23 Sep 2026 sampling); no nonstop — one stop via FRA/DUB/CDG/CPH/ZRH/ROM etc.
items.description: Outbound Tue 13 Oct, return Mon 19 Oct. No nonstop SFO–MLA exists; expect one or two connections each way.
items.notes: Point-in-time OTA sampling (KAYAK/flightroutes/flightconnections, 23 Sep 2026) — fares move daily; re-sample when booking. If the prize pays this, actual = $0 to you (but it is prize FMV for tax — see exp-tax).

items.name: Hotel — AX ODYCY, Qawra (6 nights, Deluxe sea view)
items.address: AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta
items.hours: Check-in Tue 13 Oct / check-out Mon 19 Oct 2026
items.price_range: Market band ≈ €90–160/night mid-Oct in Qawra (estimate) → ≈ $620–1,100 for 6 nights
items.description: Your booking: AX ODYCY, Deluxe sea view, 13–19 Oct 2026 (6 nights). Enter the confirmed total (incl. any resort fees/eco-tax the hotel adds) as the actual.
items.notes: Hotel verified (official site). The nightly market band is a third-party estimate — the confirmed booking price comes from your confirmation. Whether the prize or you pay is set in `covered_by`.

items.name: Airport transfers (MLA ↔ Qawra)
items.hours: Arrival Tue 13 Oct; departure Mon 19 Oct
items.price_range: Bus €2.50–3.50 each way (TD1/TD5/214/X3) · taxi €25–28 fixed each way · rideshare ≈ €15–30 each way
items.description: Two airport runs. Cheapest: Airport Direct/214 bus. Most convenient with luggage: white-taxi kiosk or rideshare.
items.notes: Bus fares official (re-read 9 Oct 2026); taxi/rideshare bands are guide estimates (mappytravel/airporttocitycenter/appsavvytraveller).

items.name: Local transport (week)
items.description: The week's island transport: unlimited bus card (covers all event-day 186/214 runs + night routes) plus a few rideshare/taxi runs for fixed times.
items.notes: Card price official (€25, re-read 9 Oct 2026). Rideshare band is an estimate. Summer single fare €2.50 applies 13–18 Oct; winter €2.00 from 19 Oct (if you buy singles instead of the card).

items.name: Food & drink ($30/day × 7 days)
items.price_range: $30/day target ≈ €26/day: pastizzi breakfast €3–5, café lunch €6–10, mid-range dinner €10–20; one or two splurge dinners push the high band
items.description: 7 days (13–19 Oct) of eating. The hotel's Deck & Keel buffet may cover breakfast (check your rate); near-hotel picks are on Food & Drink § 0.
items.notes: The $30/day figure is your stated budget; the band is this site's arithmetic (see costs.html § 6 reality check). Enter actuals per day if you track them.

items.name: TWC 2026 Finals ticket
items.area: BLAST Arena Studios, Ta' Qali, Attard
items.address: Malta Fairs & Conventions Centre, Ta' Qali, ATD 4000 Ħ'Attard
items.price_range: Covered by the prize (per giveaway Terms §5) — est. FMV ~$100 if self-purchased
items.description: Your ticket to the five match days. Which days it covers is one of the written confirmations to collect.
items.notes: Prize coverage per Terms §5 (verified 23 Sep 2026, carried); the $100 FMV is an estimate (no public ticket price published — TWC does not publish a fan-zone ticketing structure).

items.name: Activities & entry fees
items.price_range: Official anchors: Malta National Aquarium €16.90 online · St John's €15 · Fort St Elmo €10 · Grand Master's Palace €12 · Ħaġar Qim & Mnajdra €10 · Tarxien €6 · St Paul's Catacombs €6 · Hypogeum €35 · harbour ferry €3/€5 · Gozo €4.65–15 · HM Multisite Pass €60
items.description: Sights & activities for the week: aquarium (near hotel), Valletta set, maybe Gozo/Comino. Typical mix €45–80; with Hypogeum + Gozo €80–115.
items.notes: Aquarium price official (9 Oct 2026); Heritage Malta/St John's prices official (24 Sep 2026, carried); ferry fares official (24 Sep 2026). Blue Grotto boats €10/€5 (2026 guides, conflict shown); Comino boats unverified.

items.name: SIM / eSIM (week)
items.description: A week of phone data. eSIM (Airalo/Holafly/Ubigi/Nomad) activated before you fly, or a GO/Epic/Melita prepaid SIM at the airport.
items.notes: 2026 guide bands — re-check operator sites before buying (see everyday.html § 3b).

items.name: Malta eco-tax (6 nights)
items.hours: Charged by the hotel (often separately at the desk)
items.price_range: €1.50/night per person 18+ → €9.00 for 6 nights (≈ $10.30); visit cap €22.50 unreachable in 6 nights
items.description: Malta's Environmental Contribution on tourist accommodation, effective 1 Jul 2026. Often invoiced separately by the hotel — may not be covered by a prepaid room.
items.notes: MTA official page + 2026 guidelines PDF (verified 23 Sep 2026, carried). Corrected from the earlier 7-night €10.50 figure to 6 nights = €9.00.

items.name: DAB+/FM radio (optional)
items.description: Only if you want the live-sport radio plan (radio.html): a European DAB+/FM receiver. US radios use HD Radio and won't receive DAB+.
items.notes: Price band is an estimate (operator sells hardware via dab.com.mt/dab-products; no price captured). Skip if you only need FM.

items.name: Travel & medical insurance (week)
items.description: Medical care is not free to visitors and most US plans don't cover you abroad; private clinics expect payment up front. The giveaway Terms excluded insurance — buy your own.
items.notes: State Department health/insurance guidance (official); the $ band is a market estimate.

items.name: Buffer / incidentals
items.description: Shopping, tips, an extra night meal, souvenirs, small surprises. The line that absorbs everything unplanned.
items.notes: Planning allowance — no source needed; it is a budget line, not a price claim.

items.name: Passport renewal + expedite (if needed)
items.description: Only if your passport is expiring before ~mid-Jan 2027 (3 months past your 19 Oct departure) or was issued more than 10 years ago.
items.notes: State Department fees (official page; the specific fee sub-URL 404'd on 24 Sep 2026 — figures cross-checked against a 2026 acceptance-facility table — flag carried). $0 if your passport is fine.

items.name: Checked bag & seat fees
items.description: The giveaway Terms exclude additional baggage. If the booked fare is basic/light economy, the first checked bag on a transatlantic ticket can be $75+ each way; seat selection extra.
items.notes: Exclusion per Terms §5 (official, carried). The $ band is an estimate — ask which fare class was booked; pack carry-on-only if you can.

items.name: Est. US tax on prize FMV (if prize-funded)
items.price_range: FMV band $1,700–2,900 (flights $611–963 + hotel 6 nights ≈ $620–1,100 + ticket ~$100) × ~25–27% combined federal+CA ≈ $420–780
items.description: A won trip is taxable income at fair market value (IRS Pub 525; Form 1040 Schedule 1 line 8i; California flows through federal AGI). Only applies to the elements the prize actually pays for.
items.notes: IRS Pub 525 + FTB (official, carried). The dollar band is this site's arithmetic on those rules — not tax advice; a CPA should confirm the filing treatment. $0 if you self-fund the trip (nothing is prize income) or decline the prize (Pub 525: declining is not income).
